name: Avellanosa de Muñó (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a yellow diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Avellanosa de Muñó (a sword and a hazel tree on green).
history: Municipal flag of Avellanosa de Muñó; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
